title: Maintainer program onboarding — stipend logistics & visibility
text:
Maintainer program onboarding — stipend logistics & visibility

['From: Alex Quinn <alex@packforge.org>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Maintainer stipend onboarding and payout options

Hi Lauren —

Thanks again for the offer to support PackForge maintainers with the stipend. We really appreciate Redwood backing this work. Before we kick off, two quick operational questions so we can align with our treasurer:

1) What payment options does Redwood support for community grants? (bank transfer, ACH, wire, PayPal, or check)
2) What recurrence do you expect for stipends? One-off, monthly for 3 months, or something else?

We have a vague preference for a single quarterly payout per recipient (simpler for our bookkeeping) but can adapt. I attached our preliminary W-9 and the maintainers list with preferred contact emails.

Also: Sophie and I will be running a short panel at HackJam on Dec 8 — would Redwood want to include a 60s sponsor mention and a slide about the maintainer program?

Appreciate any onboarding checklist you can share.

—Alex
PackForge coordinator
', 'From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Quinn <alex@packforge.org>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Maintainer stipend onboarding and payout options

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear note and for sharing the W-9. This is exactly the sort of info we need. Quick answers up front: Redwood supports ACH and wire transfers for US-based orgs; for international recipients we can do wire or issue prepaid grant credits on Redwood Dedicated (if maintainers prefer compute credits vs. bank payouts). We also support issuing a single consolidated payment to an umbrella organization like PackForge if that simplifies things.

For this program we typically do either a single quarterly payout or a 3-month cadence depending on the size of the stipend. If you prefer a quarterly lump sum per recipient, we can accommodate that.

I’m looping in Rishi (finance) for vendor setup and tax confirmation and Karthik (community) for communications and activation at HackJam. Can you confirm: total number of maintainers (headcount), whether payments should go to an umbrella PackForge account or to individual maintainers, and preferred currency?

I’ll also share our onboarding checklist and vendor form (vendor-setup-form.pdf) — we just need a completed form + tax docs and a quick promotion brief for any event mention.

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Developer Partnerships | Redwood Inference
', "From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Quinn <alex@packforge.org>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Maintainer stipend onboarding and payout options

Hi Alex / Lauren —

Quick finance note and next steps:

- We can do ACH domestically (US) and wire internationally. If PackForge prefers an umbrella payment and will distribute to maintainers, we need a signed invoice from PackForge and completed vendor-setup-form (attached).
- For US entities we need W-9; for non-US entities we need W-8BEN-E or equivalent. The W-9 you attached looks complete, but please confirm the legal entity name matches the invoice.
- Payment timing: once vendor setup is complete we typically process payments on our monthly cycle. For a Q4 pledge we'll do the first payout by the end of the next Redwood pay run (usually within 30 days of vendor approval).

Attachments: vendor-setup-form.pdf, stipend-schedule.xlsx (template for suggested cadence).

If PackForge wants us to issue compute/credit grants instead of fiat payments, loop me in and we’ll coordinate accounting treatment — that can actually speed things up.

Regards,
Rishi
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
", 'From: Alex Quinn <alex@packforge.org>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophie Tan <sophie@hackjam.org>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Maintainer stipend onboarding and payout options

Thanks Rishi — that all makes sense. We’d like to receive an umbrella payment to PackForge and distribute ourselves. Total headcount for the pilot is 18 maintainers across three timezones; currency: USD.

I attached PackForge W-9 (w9-packforge.pdf) and a draft invoice (we can reformat if you need a specific template). For the HackJam panel: yes, we’d love a Redwood slide and a 60s sponsor mention; Sophie will follow up with the short promo copy.

One operational ask: can Redwood provide a short public-facing blurb (2–3 lines) we can include on the HackJam site thanking Redwood for the maintainer support? If so, who should Sophie send the copy request to?

Cheers,
Alex
', 'From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, alex@packforge.org
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Maintainer stipend onboarding and payout options

Hey team —

Happy to draft a short blurb for HackJam and a two-sentence social post. Suggested copy for the HackJam site: "Redwood Inference is proud to support PackForge maintainers through a pilot stipend program that helps open-source contributors sustain critical infrastructure."

I attached a quick promo-activation-checklist (promo-activation-checklist.md) with recommended assets, timing, and a speaker intro script for the 60s mention. Sophie, if you can share the panel timing we’ll tailor the intro.

If PackForge would like a co-branded slide, send a vector logo and high-res photo for the speaker.

—Marissa
Solutions & Community Partnerships | Redwood Inference
', 'From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Quinn <alex@packforge.org>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Maintainer stipend onboarding and payout options

All set — thanks for the quick turnaround, everyone. Next steps I’ll own:

1) Alex: please return the completed vendor-setup-form and the final invoice to rishi@redwoodinference.com by EOD Nov 19. Rishi will confirm vendor creation and estimated payment date.
2) Marissa: please finalize the HackJam blurb and send to Sophie + lauren for quick sign-off.
3) Karthik: we’ll coordinate a short public FAQ and a landing page entry for the maintainer pilot next week (I’ll assign a content owner).

I’ve added HubSpot reference HS-Deal-002184 so Ops can track. For transparency, we’ll record the payout and promotional plan in the deal.

If there are no blockers I’ll mark this as green and expect the first payout in the December pay run (pending vendor setup).

Thanks — excited to get this pilot going.

Best,
Lauren
